description: Import a local .docx file as a new DocMake template. The document's structure (headings, paragraphs, tables, styling) is converted into an editable template; afterwards you can add variables in the visual editor, or inspect the result with `get_template`. Max 10 MB.

file_path.description: Absolute path to the .docx file on this machine.

name.description: Template name. Defaults to the file name.

name: import_docx
title: Import a DOCX as template
